cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fan's on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, could you check this window latch?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why's the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fan's on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you show me which switch? There are several.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. My taxi's here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only water.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you move it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was only twenty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Let's secure the date, then count chairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the quote while you say yes. That way we won't lose the booking while you're reading it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.text: Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.text: We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Your Turn
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept responsibility for a task you believe should never have been yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're better at it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Then this is your training opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you show me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. First, accept the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name's beside bathroom duty. Here's the mop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're better at it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this is your training opportunity.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you show me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. First, accept the mop.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I took your bins out once during your holiday. I didn't volunteer for life. Tonight's yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The neighbours already send you the reminders.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll introduce you in the group as their permanent bin contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stay in it until I know what I'm doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay until you send 'I'll handle Thursday.' They can welcome you while I leave.

cards.title: What Was the Plan?
cards.instruction: Find out what was promised, scheduled, or changed without revealing that you lost track.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. What time did we settle on for Mum's birthday dinner? I'm checking the invitations.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Seven, in the private room. You booked it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Right. How have you written the restaurant name? I want everything consistent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't written anything. You're doing the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then could you proofread the booking confirmation aloud? I'll type straight from you so we don't introduce any errors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She made me throw out your paint set.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. How have you written the restaurant name? I want everything consistent.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow's hike: ridge or river? I'm checking the weather against our route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Ridge. We changed because the river path flooded.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Flood warning, then. Where are we meeting? I'll add that to the reminder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've asked me that twice. Have you forgotten your own itinerary?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm checking it works without my help. Brief me like a new recruit; I'll take notes, starting with where I report.
